tools.name: get_incident_schema
tools.description: Read the current inherited incident fields, reference targets, choices and conditional policies before creating or changing an incident. Metadata is not effective source permission; ServiceNow ACLs and business rules remain authoritative.

tools.name: resolve_incident_assignee
tools.description: Resolve a ServiceNow assignee using exact identity matches, never fuzzy matching or the first row. With no field, union exact login, email, display-name and first-name matches. Return unique, ambiguous, not_found or incomplete plus minimal candidates. Only a unique result identifies one candidate; clarify ambiguity or incomplete results before assigning. Entra email is a lookup hint, not proof of a ServiceNow identity or assignment eligibility. Does not create users or change access.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create an authorized incident using source-schema-valid business values. Resolve reference fields to exact source sys_ids first; assigned_to accepts a resolved sys_user ID or null/empty to leave unassigned. No user provisioning or access changes. Retain the operation UUID; optional supplied correlation supports read-only response-loss reconciliation. Normal source rules and notifications run. Independently read back requested fields; never replay an attempted or uncertain operation.

tools.name: update_incident
tools.description: Patch only requested incident business fields after an exact number/version preflight using the current sys_mod_count from get_incident. assigned_to takes a resolved sys_user ID or null/empty to clear; assignment group is preserved unless included. To add findings, set values.work_notes to one nonempty note within the discovered field length, optionally together with assigned_to in the same patch. Requires source journal_input metadata. This appends, never replaces description/history. Independent bounded journal readback returns work_note separately from record_fields; assignment alone is not note confirmation. Comments/other journal fields are unsupported. Source ACLs/rules and normal effects apply; reference existence is not eligibility. Not atomic CAS. Keep the original UUID and inspect get_incident_operation after partial/unknown results; never retry a sent append under any UUID.

tools.name: delete_incident
tools.description: Delete one explicitly authorized incident after exact identity/version preflight. Inspect material relationships/native effects and agree retention if deletion permission is unknown before using an incident as disposable. confirm is an API guard, not user consent. Confirm exact parent absence only; cleanup_complete remains false because hidden/dynamic related effects are not proven. No automatic child deletion or retry.

tools.name: get_incident_operation
tools.description: Read this requester's own original incident-operation receipt and current source state. For a work-note append, independently re-read its exact observed entry, or search a bounded 20-entry work-note window on that incident when the entry is unknown. Returns only the requested matching new note, with explicit observed/not_observed/unknown evidence and limitReached, not unrestricted journal history. Source ACLs apply; not_observed is not proof of absence. Does not replay writes, clear holds, or upgrade an uncertain receipt because later state matches. Parent absence does not prove complete cleanup.
